measures.name: 直近原価合計
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedDate = SELECTEDVALUE(tbl_date_bridge[F_作業日])
RETURN
    ROUND(
        SUMX(tbl_item_bridge, ROUND(tbl_material_cost_snapshot[直近材料費(円貨)], 2)) +
        SUMX(tbl_item_bridge, ROUND(tbl_item_bridge[直近_間接材料費], 2)) +
        SUMX(tbl_item_bridge, ROUND(tbl_item_bridge[直近_直接労務費(円貨)], 2)) +
        SUMX(tbl_item_bridge, ROUND(tbl_item_bridge[直近_間接労務費(円貨)], 2)) +
        SUMX(tbl_item_bridge, ROUND(tbl_item_bridge[直近_製造経費(円貨)], 2)),
        2
    )

measures.name: 年間平均原価
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedDate = SELECTEDVALUE(tbl_date_bridge[F_作業日])
VAR OneYearAgo = EDATE(SelectedDate, -12)
RETURN
AVERAGEX(
    FILTER(
        tbl_sales,
        tbl_sales[F_作業日] >= OneYearAgo &&
        tbl_sales[F_作業日] <= SelectedDate
    ),
    [直近原価合計]
)

measures.name: 売上
measures.expression: SUMX(tbl_sales, tbl_sales[F_数量] * tbl_sales[F_契約単価])

measures.name: 品目別データ
measures.expression:
SUMMARIZE(
    tbl_sales,
    tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号],
    "売上金額", SUMX(tbl_sales, tbl_sales[F_契約単価] * tbl_sales[F_数量]),
    "原価合計", 
        SUMX(tbl_material_price, tbl_material_price[仕入単価]) +
        SUMX(tbl_labor_costs_direct, tbl_labor_costs_direct[直接労務費]) +
        SUMX(tbl_labor_costs_indirect, tbl_labor_costs_indirect[間接労務費]) +
        SUMX(tbl_indirect_material_costs, tbl_indirect_material_costs[間接材料費]) +
        SUMX(tbl_manufacturing_costs, tbl_manufacturing_costs[製造経費]),
    "利益", 
        SUMX(tbl_sales, tbl_sales[F_契約単価] * tbl_sales[F_数量]) - 
        (
            SUMX(tbl_material_price, tbl_material_price[仕入単価]) +
            SUMX(tbl_labor_costs_direct, tbl_labor_costs_direct[直接労務費]) +
            SUMX(tbl_labor_costs_indirect, tbl_labor_costs_indirect[間接労務費]) +
            SUMX(tbl_indirect_material_costs, tbl_indirect_material_costs[間接材料費]) +
            SUMX(tbl_manufacturing_costs, tbl_manufacturing_costs[製造経費])
        )
)

measures.name: 利益
measures.expression: [売上] - [直近原価合計]

measures.name: 利益率
measures.expression: DIVIDE([利益], [売上], BLANK())

measures.name: 直近材料費_old
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        tbl_sales,
        "MaterialCost",
            SUMX (
                FILTER (
                    tbl_BOM,
                    tbl_BOM[F_納入品目番号] = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
                ),
                VAR MatNo = tbl_BOM[F_材料番号]
                VAR QtyPer = tbl_BOM[数量]
                VAR SaleDate = tbl_sales[F_作業日]
                VAR UnitPrice =
                    CALCULATE (
                        MAX(tbl_material_price[仕入単価]),
                        TOPN (
                            1,
                            FILTER (
                                tbl_material_price,
                                tbl_material_price[F_材料番号] = MatNo &&
                                tbl_material_price[F_開始日] <= SaleDate
                            ),
                            tbl_material_price[F_開始日],
                            DESC
                        )
                    )
                RETURN
                    QtyPer * UnitPrice
            )
    ),
    [F_数量] * [MaterialCost]
)

measures.name: 直近_間接材料費
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    tbl_sales,
    VAR ItemNo   = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
    VAR WorkDate = tbl_sales[F_作業日]
    VAR Qty      = tbl_sales[F_数量]

    -- 作業日以前の直近日付
    VAR LatestIMDate =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_indirect_material_costs ),
                    tbl_indirect_material_costs[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
                    tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付] <= WorkDate
                ),
                tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付], DESC
            ),
            tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付]
        )

    -- 直近日付の全行を合算
    VAR IMRows =
        FILTER (
            ALL ( tbl_indirect_material_costs ),
            tbl_indirect_material_costs[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
            tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付] = LatestIMDate
        )

    VAR UnitIM =
        IF (
            ISBLANK ( LatestIMDate ) || ISEMPTY ( IMRows ),
            BLANK (),
            SUMX ( IMRows, tbl_indirect_material_costs[間接材料費] )
        )

    RETURN
        COALESCE ( Qty * UnitIM, 0 )
)

measures.name: 標準_間接材料費
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    tbl_sales,
    VAR ItemNo       = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
    VAR WorkDate     = tbl_sales[F_作業日]
    VAR Qty          = tbl_sales[F_数量]
    VAR BaselineDate = DATE ( YEAR ( WorkDate ) - 1, 12, 31 )

    -- 基準日（前年12/31）以前の直近日付
    VAR LatestIMDateStd =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_indirect_material_costs ),
                    tbl_indirect_material_costs[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
                    tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付] <= BaselineDate
                ),
                tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付], DESC
            ),
            tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付]
        )

    -- 直近日付の全行を合算
    VAR IMRowsStd =
        FILTER (
            ALL ( tbl_indirect_material_costs ),
            tbl_indirect_material_costs[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
            tbl_indirect_material_costs[日付] = LatestIMDateStd
        )

    VAR UnitIM =
        IF (
            ISBLANK ( LatestIMDateStd ) || ISEMPTY ( IMRowsStd ),
            BLANK (),
            SUMX ( IMRowsStd, tbl_indirect_material_costs[間接材料費] )
        )

    RETURN
        COALESCE ( Qty * UnitIM, 0 )
)

measures.name: 標準_間接労務費(円貨)
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    tbl_sales,
    VAR ItemNo       = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
    VAR WorkDate     = tbl_sales[F_作業日]
    VAR Qty          = tbl_sales[F_数量]
    VAR BaselineDate = DATE ( YEAR ( WorkDate ) - 1, 12, 31 )

    -- 基準日（前年12/31）以前の直近日付
    VAR LatestIndDateStd =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_labor_costs_indirect ),
                    tbl_labor_costs_indirect[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
                    tbl_labor_costs_indirect[日付] <= BaselineDate
                ),
                tbl_labor_costs_indirect[日付], DESC
            ),
            tbl_labor_costs_indirect[日付]
        )

    -- 直近日付の全行を合算対象に抽出
    VAR IndRowsStd =
        FILTER (
            ALL ( tbl_labor_costs_indirect ),
            tbl_labor_costs_indirect[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
            tbl_labor_costs_indirect[日付] = LatestIndDateStd
        )

    -- レート（IDR）：LatestIndDateStd 以前の直近
    VAR RateIDR =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_rate ),
                    NOT ISBLANK ( tbl_rate[IDR_レート] ) &&
                    tbl_rate[月_レート] <= LatestIndDateStd
                ),
                tbl_rate[月_レート], DESC
            ),
            tbl_rate[IDR_レート]
        )

    -- 行ごとに換算してから合算（同日付は全件）
    VAR UnitLaborJPY =
        IF (
            ISBLANK ( LatestIndDateStd ) || ISEMPTY ( IndRowsStd ),
            BLANK (),
            SUMX (
                IndRowsStd,
                tbl_labor_costs_indirect[間接労務費] *
                    IF ( tbl_labor_costs_indirect[通貨] = "IDR", RateIDR, 1 )
            )
        )

    RETURN
        COALESCE ( Qty * UnitLaborJPY, 0 )
)

measures.name: 標準_直接労務費(円貨)
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    tbl_sales,
    VAR ItemNo      = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
    VAR WorkDate    = tbl_sales[F_作業日]
    VAR Qty         = tbl_sales[F_数量]

    -- 基準日：作業日の前年12月31日
    VAR BaselineDate =
        DATE ( YEAR ( WorkDate ) - 1, 12, 31 )

    -- 基準日以前の直近（同日付は全件合算対象）
    VAR LatestLaborDateStd =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_labor_costs_direct ),
                    tbl_labor_costs_direct[品目番号] = ItemNo
                        && tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付] <= BaselineDate
                ),
                tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付], DESC
            ),
            tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付]
        )

    VAR LaborRowsStd =
        FILTER (
            ALL ( tbl_labor_costs_direct ),
            tbl_labor_costs_direct[品目番号] = ItemNo
                && tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付] = LatestLaborDateStd
        )

    -- レート（IDR）：LatestLaborDateStd 以前の直近
    VAR RateIDR =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_rate ),
                    NOT ISBLANK ( tbl_rate[IDR_レート] )
                        && tbl_rate[月_レート] <= LatestLaborDateStd
                ),
                tbl_rate[月_レート], DESC
            ),
            tbl_rate[IDR_レート]
        )

    -- 行ごとに換算してから合算（同日付は全件）
    VAR UnitCostJPY =
        IF (
            ISBLANK ( LatestLaborDateStd ) || ISEMPTY ( LaborRowsStd ),
            BLANK (),
            SUMX (
                LaborRowsStd,
                tbl_labor_costs_direct[直接労務費]
                    * IF ( tbl_labor_costs_direct[通貨] = "IDR", RateIDR, 1 )
            )
        )

    RETURN
        COALESCE ( Qty * UnitCostJPY, 0 )
)

measures.name: 標準_材料費_old
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        FILTER (
            tbl_sales,
            NOT ISBLANK(tbl_sales[F_作業日]) &&
            NOT ISBLANK(tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号])
        ),
        "MaterialCost",
            VAR RefDate = DATE(YEAR(tbl_sales[F_作業日]) - 1, 12, 31)
            VAR Materials =
                FILTER (
                    tbl_BOM,
                    tbl_BOM[F_納入品目番号] = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
                )
            VAR WithPrice =
                ADDCOLUMNS (
                    Materials,
                    "UnitPrice",
                        CALCULATE (
                            MAX(tbl_material_price[仕入単価]),
                            FILTER (
                                tbl_material_price,
                                tbl_material_price[F_材料番号] = tbl_BOM[F_材料番号] &&
                                tbl_material_price[F_開始日] <= RefDate
                            )
                        )
                )
            VAR MissingPrice =
                COUNTROWS (
                    FILTER (WithPrice, ISBLANK([UnitPrice]))
                ) > 0
            VAR Cost =
                SUMX (
                    WithPrice,
                    [UnitPrice] * tbl_BOM[数量]
                )
            RETURN
                IF (
                    MissingPrice,
                    BLANK(),
                    Cost * tbl_sales[F_数量]
                )
    ),
    [MaterialCost]  // BLANK はそのまま保持。合計にも反映される
)

measures.name: 直近_直接労務費(円貨)
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    tbl_sales,
    VAR ItemNo   = tbl_sales[F_在庫品目番号]
    VAR WorkDate = tbl_sales[F_作業日]
    VAR Qty      = tbl_sales[F_数量]

    -- 作業日以前の直近日付を特定
    VAR LatestLaborDate =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_labor_costs_direct ),
                    tbl_labor_costs_direct[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
                    tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付] <= WorkDate
                ),
                tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付], DESC
            ),
            tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付]
        )

    -- 直近日付＝LatestLaborDate の行を全件抽出（同日付はすべて集計）
    VAR LaborRows =
        FILTER (
            ALL ( tbl_labor_costs_direct ),
            tbl_labor_costs_direct[品目番号] = ItemNo &&
            tbl_labor_costs_direct[日付] = LatestLaborDate
        )

    -- WorkDate以前の直近レート（IDR用）
    VAR RateIDR =
        MAXX (
            TOPN (
                1,
                FILTER (
                    ALL ( tbl_rate ),
                    NOT ISBLANK ( tbl_rate[IDR_レート] ) &&
                    tbl_rate[月_レート] <= WorkDate
                ),
                tbl_rate[月_レート], DESC
            ),
            tbl_rate[IDR_レート]
        )

    -- 同日付の行を合算（行ごとに通貨判定、IDRならRateIDRを適用）
    VAR UnitCostJPY =
        IF (
            ISBLANK ( LatestLaborDate ) || ISEMPTY ( LaborRows ),
            BLANK (),
            SUMX (
                LaborRows,
                tbl_labor_costs_direct[直接労務費] *
                    IF ( tbl_labor_costs_direct[通貨] = "IDR", RateIDR, 1 )
            )
        )

    RETURN
        COALESCE ( Qty * UnitCostJPY, 0 )
)

measures.name: 費目_差額率
measures.expression:
VAR latest =
    SWITCH(
        SELECTEDVALUE(tbl_cost_categories[費目]),
        "材料費", [直近材料費(円貨)],
        "直接労務費", [直近_直接労務費(円貨)],
        "間接労務費", [直近_間接労務費(円貨)],
        "間接材料費", [直近_間接材料費],
        "製造経費", [直近_製造経費(円貨)]
    )

VAR standard =
    SWITCH(
        SELECTEDVALUE(tbl_cost_categories[費目]),
        "材料費", [標準_材料費(円貨)],
        "直接労務費", [標準_直接労務費(円貨)],
        "間接労務費", [標準_間接労務費(円貨)],
        "間接材料費", [標準_間接材料費],
        "製造経費", [標準_製造経費(円貨)]
    )

RETURN
IF(
    ISBLANK(standard),
    BLANK(),
    DIVIDE(latest - standard, standard)
)

measures.name: 直近材料費(円貨)
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    tbl_material_cost_snapshot,
    tbl_material_cost_snapshot[材料費合計] *
        SWITCH (
            TRUE(),
            tbl_material_cost_snapshot[データ取得元] = "BEI",
                LOOKUPVALUE(
                    tbl_rate[IDR_レート],
                    tbl_rate[月_レート],
                        CALCULATE(
                            MAX(tbl_rate[月_レート]),
                            FILTER(
                                tbl_rate,
                                tbl_rate[月_レート] <= RELATED(tbl_date_bridge[F_作業日])
                            )
                        )
                ),
            tbl_material_cost_snapshot[データ取得元] = "BEE", 1,
            BLANK()
        )
)
